_why: A package name that is not an identifier (`sanitize_pkg` must be the SAME function on both sides, or one producer emits `::talker-pkg::register`, which does not compile) and a node at the ROOT namespace. An empty-vs-`/` namespace is a fact the two producers derive from different inputs — the macro from an FQN, the CLI from a launch attribute — so it is exactly where they can disagree while both look right.
